name: Blueprint Marketplace
summary: Distribute versioned Process Application Blueprints from independently operated registries, safely import/update packages while retaining local edits, and keep commercial entitlements separate from execution.
next_action: Review PR #1416 Console browse/preview/import integration and required CI; then persist trusted Blueprint provenance in design-time sidecar state and prove restart recovery with a signed public demo.

slices.title: Registry and trust contract
slices.note: Complete: ADR-0499 Accepted; signed v1 schema, positive/negative fixtures and offline Ed25519/SHA-256 verifier landed in PR #1402 and #1405. Offline verifications only; no registry transport or installs.

slices.title: Free registry to installed application
slices.note: PR #1411 merged the pinned HTTPS transport; PR #1415 merged bounded archive inspection. Draft PR #1416 adds operator-pinned signed registry browse/preview and explicit Console import through existing authorization/conflict APIs. Persistent provenance, restart test and a signed demo registry are still required.

slices.title: Provenance and managed updates
slices.note: Pin version and digest, preserve local edits, test conflict/rollback/failure behavior and provenance recovery.

slices.title: Private and federated registries
slices.note: Mock authenticated/private sources and provider-neutral entitlements; no payments or runtime licensing in core.
